t: A free Python editor in one web page that runs in the browser.
steps: Find PyRunner on its itch.io page or repository and download PyRunner_1.0.html.
Review the file with IT. The README says an AI coding tool wrote the code.
Open the file in a modern browser while online.
Run an example to check that Python loads.
Try a program that uses input.
Share a program through a URL and test that the link opens.
Host the file on a school page if students need a shared address.
